data.long_meaning: In Latin, Linet means 'thread' or 'linen'. This name is derived from the Latin word 'linum', which refers to the flax plant from which linen is made. Linen is known for its strength and durability, making Linet a name with a strong and enduring meaning. The name Linet carries the meaning “Thread, linen” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Linet usually hope their child will grow to embody thread, linen and live with faith, good character and purpose.
